# NRLMSISE-00: sources, licences and fixtures

## The model and its coefficients (`src/nrlmsise00.rs`, `src/nrlmsise00_data.rs`)

NRLMSISE-00 is an empirical atmosphere model of the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory (J. Geophys.
Res. 107(A12), 1468, 2002, doi:10.1029/2002JA009430). It is U.S. Government work,
not subject to copyright protection in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105). As 17 U.S.C. 403
requires for works consisting predominantly of U.S. Government material: the coefficient
tables in `src/nrlmsise00_data.rs` and the algorithm of `src/nrlmsise00.rs` are U.S.
Government material and are not subject to copyright protection.

Sources consulted:

| file | where from | SHA-256 | licence |

The information and software may be used freely by the public." |
| `nrlmsise-00.c`, `nrlmsise-00_data.c`, `nrlmsise-00.h`, `DOCUMENTATION` (C port, release 20190709) | `src/c_nrlmsise-00/` of the PyPI sdist `nrlmsise00-0.1.2.tar.gz` (sdist SHA-256 `db963744986f560e8270f83f9a627485c12e52b199fc4cf532e91984940114fb`) | `.c` `a20d6523420188241963f095ad0b65df44ac0a6fa6db52d2e1df823c366f0285`; `_data.c` `d0b3022f3c3e7ffdf703cc0e0d02339dfee01c0bf1520b29c68d5f4afd8784d5`; `.h` `d5b45be690bbc6cf394f69b18c0e641a1769da0a87015704fdabf0e7560794aa`; `DOCUMENTATION` `e7db72964c22861e446d4b61931a22a58c32eeaa7f9bb23b45d887751b4ecae3` | placed in the public domain by its author, "contingent on the original Fortran code not being subject to US copyright" (`COPYING.NRLMSISE-00`), which it is not (above). The Python wrapper of that sdist is GPLv2; nothing of the wrapper is used. |

`src/nrlmsise00_data.rs` is generated by `xval/nrlmsise00-pymsis/gen_data_rs.py` from
`nrlmsise-00_data.c` (a transcription of the Fortran `BLOCK DATA GTD7BK`): the 3300 numbers
are copied as written, no arithmetic; `ptm`, declared `[50]` in C with 10 values, keeps its 10.
`src/nrlmsise00.rs` follows `nrlmsise-00.c` function by function (`tselec`, `glatf`, `ccor`,
`ccor2`, `scalh`, `dnet`, `splini`, `splint`, `spline`, `densm`, `densu`, `globe7`, `glob7s`,
`gts7`, `gtd7`, `gtd7d`); `ghp7` is not ported.

## Fixtures in this directory

| file | what | generator |
|---|---|---|
| `pymsis_grid.txt` | 720 points: pymsis 0.13.0 `version=0` (NRL Fortran `GTD7D`, METERS, all switches 1, daily Ap) total mass density (kg/m³, 10 significant figures) and temperature (K). pymsis is MIT-licensed (Copyright 2020 Regents of the University of Colorado); wheel `pymsis-0.13.0-cp313-cp313-manylinux_2_27_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl`, SHA-256 `2205b194a5479ceb0f7ebd8ff17f4b0873bcd06a7fa692c08257097191220e12`, installed in `/root/kshana-oracles/.venv` (Python 3.13). | `xval/nrlmsise00-pymsis/gen_pymsis.py` |
| `cport_grid.txt` | the same 720 points from the C port above (`gtd7d`, double precision, `%.17e`), built with `gcc -O0`. | `xval/nrlmsise00-pymsis/gen_c_oracle.sh` + `c_oracle.c` |
| `c_test_output.txt` | the C distribution's published test-driver output (`DOCUMENTATION` section 7, lines 159–191), the 17 standard cases, values verbatim. | copied by hand (17 lines) |

The grid itself is `xval/nrlmsise00-pymsis/grid.py`.
